info.name: PayMongo Checkout Sessions Payment Intents API

items.docs: Creates a Payment Intent that tracks the lifecycle of a payment. Uses the secret API key. Amount is an integer in centavos (minimum 2000 = PHP 20.00 for most methods).

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the resource (e.g. pi_..., pm_..., pay_...).

params.name: client_key
params.description: Client key allowing retrieval with the public key (client-side).

info.name: Attach a Payment Method to a Payment Intent

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the resource (e.g. pi_..., pm_..., pay_...).

items.docs: Attaches a Payment Method to a Payment Intent to attempt the payment. For redirect-based methods (GCash, GrabPay, Maya) the response contains a next_action.redirect.url the customer must be sent to.
